self_hash_policy: No recursive self hash: history-provenance.json exact file hash is recorded in the external TASK-003 validation log.

transformations.historical: All original hashes independently matched TASK-001 before extraction. Native identity/time, parsed legacy reports, captured late raw, selected legacy aggregate, exact interruption event and prompt-free script line slices are copied. C and expected states/counts are derived explicitly; no historical build/attempted/cycle objects are fabricated.
transformations.synthetic: boundary-cases.json and probe-target.txt are new independently authored contract vectors; no historical source hash or historical execution is claimed.
transformations.no_self_hash: Provenance file hash is external to avoid a self-reference cycle.
